messages:
sara: heads up — prod token/sec dropped ~25% around 08:12 UTC after the scheduler-kernel-routing merge. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/d/ops/ctb-tokensec?orgId=1 :eyes:
jamal: wow that’s pretty big. did the rollout job finish ok? any error spikes?
kai: perf-bot flagged a CI perf regression on the merge commit too (build #6789). linking the CI summary: https://ci.redwood/6789/perf-report. flamegraph attached in the report — big spend in kernel_selector::choose_path
perf-bot: CI perf test failed: token_rate drop -18% vs baseline on xlarge. Regression likely in commit 9f2c4b2 (scheduler: prefer kernel B for mid-length sequences).
sara: noticed KV cache hit rate also fell ~6% at the same time. logs show more cold-start kernel loads and higher memcopy on the hot path.
nora: can you paste the pprof output kai? curious if it’s memcopy vs compute-bound.
kai: paste: ```
# pprof snapshot
samples: 1000
kernel_selector::choose_path 42%  (kernel_b memcpy path)
continuous_batcher::drain 18%
kvcache::get 9%
memcpy 26% (hot)
```
jamal: that memcpy number is suspicious. commit 9f2c4b2 added a fast-path that routes some batches to kernel B which does an extra device-host memcpy for alignment. we thought it was negligible.
sara: running a quick bisect locally. git range is 9a1..a2f (last 24h). will try to narrow to the exact PR.
kai: local microbench: `./tools/bench_tokens --model t4x --threads 8` shows token/sec -28% when kernel selection policy set to 'prefers_B'. switching to 'legacy' restores baseline.
nora: given this is causing both CI and prod degradations, i'd recommend putting rollout on hold and reverting the kernel selection change until we fix the memcpy path.
sara: agreed — placing the rollout on hold. @deploy-bot can you initiate a rollback to 9a1e4b0?
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: deploy 9a1e4b0 -> prod. ETA ~6m. :truck:
jamal: while rollback runs, can someone open a small PR to gate the policy behind a feature flag and add a memcpy budget check in the selector? we need a test that fails if memcpy > 10% of hotpath.
kai: filing PR now, will add a perf unit test and a kv-hit smoke test.
sara: after rollback completes we should watch token/sec and kv hit dashboards for 30m before un-holding.
perf-bot: deploy 9a1e4b0 -> prod completed successfully. post-deploy token/sec back within 2% of baseline. :tada:
nora: great. follow-up items: (1) revert patch or add feature flag (2) add CI perf test that runs kernel-selection microbench on merge, (3) investigate whether kernel B memcpy can be eliminated. I'll create tickets.
sara: thanks everyone — good triage. keeping this thread for postmortem notes and timeline.
